Definition: from βαίνω (to walk); a pace ("base"), i.e. (by implication) the foot:--foot.
BiblicalUsage: Basis means a step, the foot, and it appears once, when Peter takes the lame man by the right hand and his feet and ankle bones receive strength.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the lame man's feet are the proof of the miracle, because the feet that never walked are the first thing God makes strong.
